# Reified Data

- `Reified.Data` is a standalone fixture and produced-data package with no dependencies on other Reified packages.
- Open `Reified.DataDSL`; construct with `data`, derive values with `patch`, `variants`, or `matrix`, and match with
  `at`, `absent`, `containing`, and explicit list patterns.
- Use `Data.compare` when the complete tree is the contract and partial patterns when only selected evidence matters.
- `Data.render` and `Data.renderIndented` are human-readable displays; `Data.Json.render` and
  `Data.Json.renderIndented` produce portable JSON text.
- On .NET 8+, copy native `JsonElement` and `JsonDocument` values with `Data.ofJsonElement` and
  `Data.ofJsonDocument`. Under Fable, pass a native `JSON.parse` result to `Data.ofJsonValue` when duplicate fields and
  original number-token spelling do not matter.
- `Reified.Json.parseData` provides portable, lossless JSON-to-`Data` parsing from the `Reified.Schema` package.
- Adapt sources with `Data.ofCliArgs`, `Data.ofConfiguration` (`:` keys), and `Data.ofEnvironment` /
  `Data.ofEnvironmentWith` (`__` names, optional prefix; caller-supplied pairs, no I/O). Sections use canonical
  ASCII decimal indexes only; `00` never aliases `0`. Text/null leaves and null gaps count toward bounded output.
  Defaults: 10000 items/list, 100000 output nodes including root/containers/gaps, 64 path segments. Override positive
  limits with `Data.ofConfigurationWith` or `DataEnvironmentOptions.Limits`. Supplied non-null leaves are text
  for the schema to parse.
- Layer configuration with `Data.mergeAll [ file; environment; cli ]`: right-biased deep merge of objects; lists,
  scalars, and `Data.Null` on the right replace; a later null overrides and never removes a key.
